theorem: Selector Qutrit Phase Bundle Theorem.  The 120 BT360 selector sheets are exactly a 3-sheet qutrit phase fiber over the 40 lines of W(3,3).  The 54-overlap relation gives the same-line K3 fibers.  Collapsing those fibers recovers the W(3,3) line-intersection SRG.  Intersecting base lines have full K3,3 phase coupling at overlap 12; skew base lines carry a canonical relative-phase perfect matching at overlap 4 with the other six phase pairs at overlap 2.
title: Selector sheets are a qutrit phase bundle over W(3,3) lines
